answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade: creating a fake identity then costs real capital, and the stake is slashed if peers catch the agent double-spending or lying. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fees, so an oasis of trusted traders grows while a karst of hollow shells drains away - like yarrow spreading only where the soil is genuinely tended, reputation compounds only for identities that keep paying the cost of behaving well.
